features.text: Advanced spinal support system delivers targeted compression for degenerative disc disease and stenosis management during daily activities
Cold-moldable aluminum PTE technology ensures anatomically correct stabilization for chronic spine conditions and instability
Innovative compression design provides therapeutic support for spinal stenosis while allowing prescribed mobility
Professional-grade construction maintains proper spine alignment during recovery from DDD-related symptoms and surgical procedures

measurement: For optimal spinal support, measure from the sacrum to C7 vertebra along the spine's natural curve. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for expert sizing assistance and a guaranteed perfect fit.
